text: A truck that can't even turn into the factory lane? [short pause] Now picture a road twenty-four metres wide. Three things a planned industrial plot gives you. One: roads. Eighteen and twenty-four metres wide, built for trucks. Two: reach. Ten minutes to NH one-fifty-two D. Twenty-five to IMT Rohtak. Three: [short pause] it's approved. H-RERA registration six-five-three of twenty twenty-five, with DTCP licences. This is Fortasia Industrial Township, Rohtak. A hundred and thirty-eight acres. Plots from five hundred to four thousand square yards. For factory owners ready to move: tap below, and get the plan on WhatsApp.
